selection: Sections 3.4 and 4 favor X≈0.13 from the combined light-curve and thermal constraints; this representative model is not a unique inversion.

scale.interpretation: Volume-normalized to the existing JPL nominal radius. This is a display convention; do not interpret the paper’s effective thermal diameter as a uniquely measured volume diameter.

pole.conversionInterpretation: J2000 ecliptic-to-equatorial display convention; no unique measured pole or absolute meridian.

captionDiscrepancy: Figure 8 caption prints X=0.0133 in the manuscript. Sections 2.3, 3.4 and 4 explicitly use X=0.133 for the plotted feasible solution and long/short≈1.3. The recipe follows the explicit equations and repeated text, not that inconsistent caption decimal.
terrain: No measured spatial terrain or reflectance map is inferred from the thermal roughness parameter. All surface texels remain missing-data grid.
